build_review.toolchain: local Go 1.27.0 satisfies go 1.26.9; GOTOOLCHAIN=local, GOWORK=off, GOPROXY=off, CGO_ENABLED=0
build_review.reviewed_policy: Do not invoke Makefile install/release and run-that-app bootstrap targets; direct build compiles only the root Go command and vendor tree.

hook_review.makefile_bootstrap: Make targets use tools/rta and may download it through run-that-app; install/release targets are excluded.
hook_review.CI_dependencies: Pinned Ubuntu cuke workflow installs Spanish language packs and invokes make cukeall. Windows workflow invokes make cukesmokewin. Campaign owns its narrow native cases; no upstream install workflow or package-manager scripts run.

state_oracle: Use spec v3 rooted state assertions on exact .git/HEAD and selected .git/config content from the synthetic repo fixture; test path acceptance, fixture copying and same-run ordering before freezing cases.
isolation: Synthetic repository with no remote; per-case empty Git/forge configuration and home; unset forge credentials; no network commands. Git Town is a local process, not a sandbox.
source_review_status: Pinned tree and runtime/build path reviewed; do not claim cases or platform qualification until native execution.
